name: Command
text:
Place an **order token** within 12" of this fighter and select one of the effects below:

- **Seize:** Until the end of the battle round, friendly fighters may add 1 to their Fight or Shoot characteristic when attacking a target within 2" of that token.
- **Hold:** Until the end of the battle round, subtract 1 from the Bravery characteristic of friendly fighters within 2" of that token.

name: Strategize
text: The next time this fighter makes a wait action this activation, roll (X) dice. For each roll of 4+, you may add 1 wyrd dice to your saved wyrd dice.

name: Martial Discipline
text: When this fighter is recruited to the warband you may increase its Fight or Shoot characteristic by 1.

name: Lead By Example
text: A fighter can use this ability after taking an enemy fighter out of action. Select up to two visible friendly fighters with the `HENCHMAN` keyword within 6" of this fighter. Each of those fighters can make a free move or a free attack action.

name: Hunter's Eye
text: For this fighter's next ranged attack action, add 1 to the damage points allocated to the target by each hit and critical hit.

name: Driven by Greed
text: A fighter can only use this ability if it is carrying, or is within 1" of a wyrdstone token. Add 1 to the Fight and Attacks characteristics of this fighter's next melee attack action.
